### A “Mighty Man of Valor”
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/a-mighty-man-of-valor-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-september-11-2015.html
Passage: Judges 6:13
Points:
- Like Gideon, believers often look at difficult circumstances and wonder where God's wonders have gone.
- Gideon was hiding in fear and humiliation when the angel of the Lord appeared to him.
- Even when Gideon voiced confusion and questioned God, the Lord responded with a commission rather than a rebuke.
- God called Gideon a mighty man of valor because He saw who Gideon would become in His strength.
- The Lord invites insecure believers to step out and fulfill what He calls them to do.

### God’s Mighty Warrior
Author: Arlene Pellicane
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-april-18-2017.html
Passage: Judges 6:12
Points:
- Feeling overwhelmed, inadequate, or like hiding does not disqualify someone from serving God.
- The Lord meets ordinary people in the privacy of routine duties, just as He met Gideon threshing wheat.
- God views His children as warriors of faith regardless of their past, social status, or perceived insignificance.
- Although Gideon felt completely unqualified, he was teachable and listened to God's word.
- Believers can step out boldly knowing God's power is perfected in human weakness.

### Gideon: A Fearful Man with a Mighty Mission
Author: Jennifer Waddle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/gideon-a-fearful-man-with-a-mighty-mission-bible-study-minute-march-6-2018.html
Passage: Judges 6:15
Points:
- Severe hardship and fear led Gideon to view himself as the weakest member of the weakest clan.
- God's declaration of Gideon's identity did not match Gideon's self-perception while hiding in a winepress.
- People often formulate lists of inadequacies to argue against answering God's call.
- The Lord specializes in using fearful and ill-equipped people so His strength is clearly demonstrated.
- Surrendering our perceived weaknesses to God opens the door for Him to raise us up for His purposes.

### How God Makes Us Mighty
Author: Liz Wann
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/how-god-makes-us-mighty
Passage: Judges 6:12
Points:
- God addressed Gideon as a valiant warrior even though Gideon consistently demonstrated fear and doubt.
- Gideon was not named a mighty man for inherent courage, but because of who God is.
- Instead of rebuking Gideon for needing reassurance, God patiently accommodated his frailty and shaped his faith.
- Experiencing God's gentle patience in our weakness teaches us to extend forbearance and grace to others.
- Jesus is the ultimate man of valor whose perfect work transforms fearful sinners into people of strength.
